title: Text: DET David Chadd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Just trying again because I didn't exactly get the same answer from you and Al. Should I feel comfortable boarding my flight to Raleigh tomorrow?
I truly can't answer that now
Is this because he's still gotta pitch? There's just a lot of crap out there and I want to make sure I'm in the right direction. I'd look like a dumbass if I'm down there and it doesn't happen.
It's still a possibility I can't tell you there is still allot to happen
